spec.name: Halloween The Last Light
spec.description: A ceremonial orange candle with a stepped spiral of raised wax, a shallow silver holder and a vivid teal magical flame. Axis-aligned cuboids preserve a chunky vanilla silhouette and open negative space.

prompt: Ritual candle with spiralling orange wax, silver holder and bright teal magical flame, ceremonial but vanilla Minecraft style. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
